bibl.title: Aswan Thin-Walled Figure Painted Bowls from Antinoupolis.
bibl.seg: Emanuela Borgia, Aswan Thin-Walled Figure Painted Bowls from Antinoupolis.
bibl.note: Re-examines a peculiar and quite rare type of thin-walled wares produced in the Aswan region. These small bowls depict on the inner surface a stylised male figure in black or brown colour, naked or with tiny white cloth, sometimes wearing a white necklace. Taking into consideration four new fragments of such ware uncovered at Antinoupolis [late Antonine or early Severan period] in past campaigns, it is possible to reassess the overall information concerning this unusual thin-walled production, which is typical of Egypt.
